'''3D-4K''' was a [[3D-4 administrative droid]] who worked for [[Oridelve Incorporated]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gavos]]. He was deactivated by [[R2-B7]] before the [[Gavos Droid Revolution]], a violent rebellion against [[Species/Legends|organic]] life forms throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] launched by [[EV-8D3]], figurehead of the [[New Droids' Rights Movement]].
